items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bobby Darin and discusses his hit 'Mack the Knife', but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any information indicating a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: No about .... what's his name? Sang 'Mack the Knife.' White guy.
Darin, greatest one I ever heard. He beats Louie with feeling on 'Mack the Knife,' I thought. Bobby Darrin is the only one that had that feeling on 'Mack the Knife.'
